meta.provenance_note: Every English field is copied from the two-page 'Contents' scope-and-sequence spread printed on pages 4-5 of the student book — the columns are UNIT, GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY, READING, LISTENING, SPEAKING, WRITING, and each entry keeps the book's own page references. Arabic titles and topic labels are OUR OWN TRANSLATIONS: this book is English-only and prints no Arabic beyond its cover and its draft stamp, exactly as the four vocational English catalogs record for the same reason. Each unit is represented as ONE lesson at scope-and-sequence depth. Unit numbering continues the year: this book prints units 06-10, and those printed numbers are kept rather than renumbered from 1, the same convention the physics and chemistry semester-2 catalogs follow.

source_books.student_book_s2: كتاب الطالب لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية الصف العاشر الفصل الثاني.pdf — 80 pages, sourceId eng-s2-student-book. Contents spread: pages 4-5.

known_gaps: THIS BOOK IS A DRAFT. 79 of its 80 pages carry the stamp «نسخة قيد الإعداد والتجهيز» (a copy under preparation); the semester-1 book carries it on none. Everything here is transcribed from that draft and may not match the final printed edition. Re-check this file against the final book when it is published. The stamp is only findable in extracted text as Arabic presentation forms, not as normal codepoints — a plain search for «قيد الإعداد» returns nothing.

One lesson per unit, at scope-and-sequence depth — same reason as semester 1: the book prints seven lesson slots per unit (LESSON 1A..7A) named only by a skill banner whose order varies, so a seven-lesson breakdown cannot be derived from the PDF without judgement.
No learning outcomes (نتاجات التعلم). This book prints none, so objectives[] is empty rather than invented.
No period counts — the English teacher's guide is not in the repo.

The LIFE SKILLS spreads (after units 6 and 8) and the end matter — Grammar Reference pp69-73, Irregular Verbs p74, Communication pp75-76 — are recorded on the units they follow but are not modelled as lessons of their own.
